title: Inside Passage Electric Cooperative, Inc — claimed by dragonforce
description:
US · Energy & Utilities · In 2004, Tlingit & Haida Regional Electric Authority was re-organized to an electric cooperative which is now known as Inside Passage Electric Cooperative, Inc.  IPEC is a non-profit, independent electric utility owned by the members we serve.  Electric cooperatives are democratically governed businesses, ensuring they are closely regulated by their consumers.
